verdict.rationale: dlt is a Python-native SDK/library itself, and it ships an official AI harness (skills, rules, MCP servers) plus an official MCP server (dlt-mcp) and llms.txt to let AI-native/agent workflows build against it, alongside standard Python SDK docs and tutorials. missing for 10: independent (non-vendor) hands-on validation of the AI harness/MCP server working end-to-end in agent workflows.
